heading: Personalized Care Services
intro: Comprehensive support designed around daily living and well-being — from a little extra help to full daily care.

items.title: Personal Care Assistance
items.description: Support with bathing, dressing, grooming, and daily routines — helping residents stay comfortable and confident.

items.title: Memory Care Support
items.description: Structured, specialized support for residents living with Alzheimer's or other forms of dementia.

items.title: Medication Management
items.description: Trained staff track, organize, and administer medications on schedule, every time.

items.title: Dining & Nutrition
items.description: Chef-prepared, dietitian-informed meals served restaurant-style, three times a day.

items.title: Housekeeping & Laundry
items.description: Regular housekeeping and laundry service, so residents can focus on living, not chores.

items.title: Social & Recreational Activities
items.description: A full calendar of group activities, outings, and events that keep residents engaged and connected.
